metricDefinitions.meaning: Counts measure agreement with publisher-displayed minute values under a declared date interpretation. They are not measured sky accuracy, religious correctness, or endorsement.
metricDefinitions.rates: exact/compared is exact agreement. nonExactRate=(compared−exact)/compared. overOneMinuteRate=(compared−withinOneMinute)/compared. Missing, ambiguous and unspecified values are never counted as exact; expected slots and exclusions remain separate.
metricDefinitions.freshness: Fresh means the specified source was obtained after that model/forecast freeze. Same publisher, overlapping years/points, runtime amendments, known development and reused sources are explicitly distinguished. Do not pool overlapping studies.
metricDefinitions.runtime: Historical own-engine studies generally used Node26.7.0/ICU78.3 with pinned IANA tzdb2026d where reported. Earlier reports may use2026a. Future timezone law and lunar announcements are not guaranteed.
metricDefinitions.mathematics: For fixed declination δ, cos(H)=(sin(h)−sin(φ)sin(δ))/(cos(φ)cos(δ)); transit±H/15 hours gives a height marker. Transit uses the equation of time and longitude. Continuous variants instead solve h_sun(t)−h_target(t)=0 with direction/domain checks. Asr shadow targets and ephemeris epochs differ by recipe.
metricDefinitions.precision: A small numerical root tolerance is not observational precision. Horizon constants incorporate different assumptions about solar radius/refraction; −50′ and literal−0.833° are distinct.
metricDefinitions.distribution: Raw third-party calendars, historical per-row reference values and source secrets are excluded. Public links and SHA256 provenance identify the evidence; they do not grant a redistribution license. Historical accuracy cannot be fully recomputed from a reference-free snapshot alone.
metricDefinitions.tests: Public snapshot tests verify the exported code, examples, provenance and numerical regressions. Their pass counts are not new source observations or new accuracy samples.
metricDefinitions.religiousScope: Institutions, software presets, countries, legal schools and scholarly positions are distinct. No country label means all Muslims in that country or all members of a madhhab. All outputs remain research, not official or notification-ready.

limitations: At northern latitude ≥55°, the model uses a seventh of the night computed from the same calendar row’s sunrise and sunset; this is not silently mirrored to the southern hemisphere.
Seasonal safe bounds may replace the angle event. Polar missing events, nonpositive shadow geometry and Asr-before-adjusted-Dhuhr are explicit quality issues, not certified prayer starts.
Use current timezone data. The historically tested Node/ICU stack was pinned to tzdb2026d; mathematical year support is not a guarantee against later timezone-law changes.
publicationNotes: The own solar engine has no Adhan runtime dependency; seasonal coefficients retain MIT attribution. The old research/msc-cli.mjs invokes V4.1, not this V4.2 recipe.
25 September 2026 public-rule audit is documented in RULE-EVIDENCE.md; existing historical studies are unchanged.
